scientific.integrity: The all-orders proof partitions Roman dominating functions by the center label and derives the exact blade admissibility polynomial directly. The finite checker independently exhausts representative small parameter pairs and is used only as a stress test, not as an infinite proof.
limitations: The theorem is stated for generalized windmills with \(n\ge2\) and \(m\ge2\).
The polynomial counts all Roman dominating functions by weight; it does not classify pointwise-minimal Roman dominating functions.
Targeted literature and database searches reduce but do not eliminate the possibility of unindexed equivalent coverage.

title: Roman domination polynomial of generalized windmill graphs
